plan.title: LLM Garbled Text and Rewrite Suggestions

narratives.Overview: Third engine: LLM detects garbled/broken sentences and proposes rewrite suggestions. Report-only (not applied by --apply in v1). Reuse Ghostreader-style LLM provider/secrets patterns. Traces: FR-LLM-1.
narratives.Acceptance: Garbled passages produce findings with suggestions. Stub/mock LLM path works in tests. --apply does not write LLM suggestions. Provider keys load from secrets/.

narrative.Overview: Provider selection and secrets load matching sister apps; stub model for tests.
Prompts/schema for nonsense, dropped words, mid-edit wreckage; emit Finding with suggestion.
Run after TypeSafe; merge into finding list; keep suggestions report-only for apply.
